items.front: When a stub resolver looks up www.example.org, who does it ask first?
items.back: The stub resolver asks the recursive resolver.

items.front: In DNS resolution, what does the recursive resolver get when it asks a root server about www.example.org?
items.back: A referral to the .org TLD server.

items.front: What does the .org TLD server return during resolution of www.example.org?
items.back: A referral to the authoritative server for example.org.

items.front: Who provides the final answer (the IP address) in DNS resolution for www.example.org?
For how long are DNS answers cached?
items.back: Answers are cached for their TTL.
